items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: So pretty soon I can feel somebody next to me. Eddie Tompkins, you know, trumpet player.

ctx.x: owned the place and he was the chef, you know. He prepared my incident steaks. A funny incident happened one day. So I'm feeling much better now ... I'm feeling much better and I feel good in the stomach so they called me Weak in those days. Eddie Tompkins really did.

items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] There was a fellow by the name of Eddie Thompkins. I thought he was a tremendous trumpet player.

ctx.x: I'm selfish about the trumpets. There was a fellow by the name of Eddie Thompkins. I thought he was a tremendous trumpet player. He worked with Lunceford's band here in New York. Tremendous trumpet player. And, Eddie Barefield.
